evidence: Trimethylaluminum (TMA) and distilled water (H 2O) were utilized as the precursors for the Al 2O3 deposition. The process pressure was 280 mTorr and 250 mTorr for the dosing of chemical precursors and the argon purging, respectively. The deposition was performed for 50 cycles; one cycle for the deposition of Al 2O3 was composed of TMA dosing (2 s), Ar purging (20 s), H 2O dosing (2 s) and Ar purging (20 s).
